identificationModule.briefTitle: A Phase II Exploratory Clinical Trial of Multiple Drug Combinations in the Treatment of Advanced Esophageal Squamous Cell Carcinoma
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase II Exploratory Clinical Trial of Multiple Drug Combinations in the Treatment of Advanced Esophageal Squamous Cell Carcinoma

leadSponsor.name: The First Affiliated Hospital of Zhengzhou University

descriptionModule.briefSummary: The purpose of this study is to observe and evaluate the efficacy and safety of multiple drug combinations in the treatment of advanced esophageal squamous cell carcinoma.
descriptionModule.detailedDescription: Immunotherapy has been widely used in patients with advanced esophageal cancer. Immunochemotherapy has become the standard treatment for advanced esophageal squamous cell carcinoma. The common second-line standard treatment is immunotherapy or chemotherapy, but that are established according to the medical evidence after the progression of chemotherapy, the preferred treatment plan after immuno-resistance needs to be explored. The purpose of this study was to explore the efficacy and safety of different drug combinations in patients with advanced esophageal cancer.

armGroups.label: CohortA：Apatinib+SHR-1210（Camrelizumab）
armGroups.description: Apatinib+SHR-1210（Camrelizumab）for ESCC who progressed or were intolerant to first-line systemic chemotherapy

armGroups.label: CohortB：Apatinib+SHR-1210（Camrelizumab）
armGroups.description: Apatinib+SHR-1210（Camrelizumab）for ESCC who have failed prior immune checkpoint inhibitor therapies

armGroups.label: CohortC：Apatinib+SHR-1316（Adebrelimab）
armGroups.description: Apatinib+SHR-1316（Adebrelimab）for ESCC who have failed prior immune checkpoint inhibitor therapies

armGroups.label: CohortD：SHR-1316（Adebrelimab）+SHR-A2009
armGroups.description: SHR-1316 was administered intravenously, 1200mg, Q3W; SHR-A2009 8mg/kg, iv, Q3W, for ESCC who have failed prior immune checkpoint inhibitor therapies.

interventions.name: SHR-1316（Adebrelimab）+SHR-A2009
